project.description: Uploads query.env for one stack. An uploaded change takes effect only after running PIC-SURE Wildfly Stack Deploy with DEPLOY_QUERY selected; the container bakes its env at create time, so a plain restart picks up nothing. A full Render PIC-SURE Service Config Templates run rotates the shared tokens and then requires redeploying gateway, operations, and query together.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Target stack identifier (for example, a or b).

hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.name: query.env
hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.description: query.env to validate and upload for the selected stack.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN_CHANGE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Allow QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN or PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN to change. Use only for a coordinated gateway, operations, and query token rotation.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# Source every shared Bash script used by Jenkins jobs. source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [[ -f "$script_file" && -x "$script_file" ]]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done shopt -u nullglob
for fn in assume_role reset_role; do if ! command -v "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: required function '$fn' was not loaded from $source_scripts_folder." >&2 exit 1 fi done
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${stack_s3_bucket:?stack_s3_bucket is required}"
ENV_FILE="query.env" ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN_CHANGE="${ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN_CHANGE:-false}" current_env="" cleanup() { if [[ -n "${current_env:-}" ]]; then rm -f "$current_env" fi reset_role } trap cleanup EXIT
# Fail closed: this file contains live credentials and is never echoed. if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" || ! -s "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then echo "Error: $ENV_FILE is missing or empty; refusing to upload." >&2 exit 1 fi
# Required non-empty keys are derived from query.env.tftpl. Intentionally blank template keys are optional. required_keys=( HPDS_AUTH_URL HPDS_OPEN_URL OPERATIONS_SERVICE_URL QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN VISUALIZATION_URL AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN ) for key in "${required_keys[@]}"; do key_count=$(grep -c "^${key}=" "$ENV_FILE" || true) if [[ "$key_count" -ne 1 ]] || ! grep -q "^${key}=." "$ENV_FILE"; then echo "Error: $ENV_FILE must define exactly one non-empty $key value; refusing to upload." >&2 exit 1 fi done
assume_role current_env=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/query.env.current.XXXXXX") if ! aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/query/${TARGET_STACK}/query.env" "$current_env" >/dev/null; then echo "Error: could not download the current query.env from S3; refusing to upload." >&2 exit 1 fi
# Shared tokens must remain byte-identical. Compare silently so credentials never enter the log. shared_tokens_changed=false for key in QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN; do if ! cmp -s <(grep "^${key}=" "$current_env") <(grep "^${key}=" "$ENV_FILE"); then shared_tokens_changed=true fi done
if [[ "$shared_tokens_changed" == true && "$ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN_CHANGE" != true ]]; then echo "Error: shared token values differ from the current S3 copy; refusing to upload." >&2 echo "QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN must match gateway, operations, and query. Use ALLOW_SHARED_TOKEN_CHANGE only for a coordinated three-service token rotation and redeploy." >&2 exit 1 fi
aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "$ENV_FILE" "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/query/${TARGET_STACK}/query.env"
